# Svelte Component Builder Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Svelte

## Overview

Builds reactive Svelte components with proper reactivity declarations, slot composition, and component lifecycle management

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [svelte-component-builder-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
svelte-component-builder-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@svelte-component-builder` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build components with reactive declarations and statements
- Implement slot-based content projection
- Create custom events with createEventDispatcher
- Design component props with proper TypeScript typing

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Svelte Component API**: Official component patterns with reactivity
- **Svelte 5 Runes**: New reactivity primitives with  and 
- **Accessibility**: Built-in a11y warnings and ARIA patterns
